title: Refunds and cancellation
summary: What happens when you cancel Okwan Pro, when a payment is refunded and when it is not.
intro: What happens when you cancel Okwan Pro, when a payment is refunded and when it is not. This is part of our [Terms of Service](/terms#plans); where an agreement you have signed with us says something different, the agreement applies.

lines: Pro is 99 US dollars a month, billed monthly in advance by card through Stripe. Each payment covers one month of Pro, starting the day it is taken, and it renews each month until you cancel.
The free plan costs nothing and needs no card.
Before you pay, the plan page in the dashboard and the payment page at Stripe both show the price, that it renews, how to cancel, and a link to this page.
You can cancel at any time from Manage billing in the dashboard, under Settings, Plan & usage.

Cancelling takes effect at the end of the month you have paid for: Pro stays on until then, no further payment is taken, and the account then returns to the free plan. Nothing in your account is deleted when it does.
A payment for Pro is not refunded, in whole or in part, once its month has started. Cancelling stops the next payment; it does not return the last one.
If we took a payment by mistake, such as charging you twice for the same month or charging you after a cancellation had taken effect, tell us and we refund that payment in full.
Where the law that applies to you gives you a right to a refund, you have it.
A plan larger than Pro is refunded as its order form or agreement says.
Email [info@globaltechstartup.com](mailto:info@globaltechstartup.com) from your sign-in address, with the date and amount of the payment.
A refund goes back through Stripe to the card that paid; how soon it shows is up to your bank.
Please write to us before asking your bank to reverse a payment. We can see what happened and put a mistake right directly, and a dispute through a bank can take weeks or months to decide.
If this policy changes, the new version is posted here with its date. A payment is covered by the version that was shown when it was made.
Global Tech Startup LLC, Wyoming, United States. Email [info@globaltechstartup.com](mailto:info@globaltechstartup.com).
